rows.en: I just am! Jiro, let's race! Hee hee…
What the heck's gotten into her? Ah, wait for me, sis! Siiis!!
We will now begin the execution of these three. Ready!
Hoi hoi!
Fire!
Kiiih! Kiiiih!
Uoh!? What is that?
The kaiju has appeared!
This is Patrol! This is Patrol! HQ, please respond! HQ, please respond!!
Damn!? Curse it… Don't let them escape! After them!!
Ah!? Go is…!!
That fool! So reckless!
Taaaah!!
…!? Ultraman?
It's 150,000 volts… Brace your stomach muscles good and hard!
Aiya…
All right, switch on!!
Uuugh…
Whoa…
Ahh…
Nuoooh!
Kuh… All right, let's deploy the New Gorenger Suits! Let's go!!

Bah… Have you still not found Gorenger?

Grr… where did they go? Search! Search! …!?

Wh-who are you?
So you've shown up again, never learning your lesson? Take your positions, attack!!
(It's the Meteor Kick! Unless I leap over its barrier, there's no victory!)
Captain! The kaiju has appeared!
…!? Request reinforcements from the TDF! Hurry!
Roger!!
Captain! The reinforcements have arrived!
Good, we'll smash it in one go!!
Whoa… What is this? Stop it!! My face is being shaved off… It hurts! Help meee!!
Captain!!
Go! Go, hang in there!!
Go!
Captain!!
Go!
Well done! That was splendid!
But… if Ultraman hadn't come, we'd have been in trouble!

No… Today wasn't Ultraman's victory alone.

It was because we all fought with one heart! Ueno… you could say you're one of the heroes too!
Me… too?
That's right.
Heh heh heh…

This is a victory for teamwork between Ultraman… and us at MAT!

Now Tokyo won't have a blackout either. Come on, let's go!
Ultraman and Gorenger had been defeated once. But they rose again with indomitable fighting spirit, and were reborn like the phoenix!
They are not invincible… But as long as their hearts hold unwavering resolve, they will rise again and again and seize victory! Until the day they hold a lasting peace in their hands…
The New Gorenger Suits… It seems they made it in time?
But, you know… what exactly is "new" about them? I can't tell the difference!
Ooh… I'm itching to fight! [HERO4], let's smash them in one go with the new combination attack!
Like I said… aren't you being a bit persistent? Haaah…
Defeat Ancient Kaiju Kingsaurus III…!
Defeat all of Kelbaan's forces!
Destroy the Mobile Fortress Navaron!
Defeat the entire Black Cross Army and Ancient Kaiju Kingsaurus III!
Defeat all of the Black Cross Army, Gigant, Kelbaan's forces, Space Kaiju Eleking, Oil Kaiju Takkong, Skull Kaiju Red King and Ancient Kaiju Kingsaurus III!
All allies are destroyed…?
Akira Shinmei is defeated
TDF Far East Base has been <c1>captured</c>
With Dr. Segawa of the International Committee for Earth Defense and the leading biologist Dr. Maeno among its main staff, a new weapon was nearing completion in a factory inside the TDF base.
It's finally here… The test of Super Weapon R1, built for attacking planets.
A new-type missile… with the explosive power of 8,000 of them!?
And this one's just the test model!
Amazing… Right, Dan?
They say it'll be launched in 48 hours.
Launched!? From this base?
That's right…
With this, Earth's defense is perfect. Any planet that tries to invade Earth will be blown to smithereens with the push of a button!!
All we have to do is keep our finger on the button and wait for anyone who tries to invade.
Better than that… let them know that Earth has a super weapon.
I see… Then they won't come to invade!

That's right.

Even without using it, just having a super weapon will protect the peace…

Dan!? What's wrong, Dan?
That monster that appeared near Mars! Even if it's after invading Earth, one shot of this and the matter's settled…

No… it's not that simple!

From what I heard, the super weapon is so powerful that at a distance like Mars, it would affect Earth too!

Bah… Let them come at us, who cares!

We've got plenty of super weapons, starting with the new Vertical Shotgun, and above all, we've got us, the Ultra Garrison!

A space fortress ship or two…
What?
Is anything allowed, as long as it's to protect the Earth!?
Huh?
Answer me!!
All right…
Hey, Dan!! Where on earth are you going?
